svg.title: PropagateSign outputs on a 2D toy tree
svg.desc: Narrow band of a circle in a 2D tree; invert bits shown at the level of the tree that holds them.
svg.text: Where the invert bits live (2D cartoon)
Invert bit on, by where it lives
Node sizes here are 4, 8 and 16 voxels on a side; in NanoVDB they are 8, 128 and 4096 (leaf 8³, lower 16³ leaves, upper 32³ lower nodes).
Each inactive location has one invert bit, held at the level of the tree that holds the location; active voxels carry their own values.
